scope.mutable_outputs: Only the six explicitly prepared K images and owned compile/log/receipt paths
scope.mechanism: Existing SealReplay calls unchanged M3GpuToolJoinManifest; no OpenRewrite SDK execution

execution_protocol.abort_following_actions_on_any_failure: Abort on unexpected result; required drift exit1 is successful refusal evidence.

supervisor.scope: Borrow definitions only; never execute the historical main

operational_reference.reuse: Definitions/protocol only; completed main must not be rerun

global_jvm_lock.acquire: One atomic mkdir; HOLD if existing. No wait loop or stale deletion.
global_jvm_lock.release: Only own unchanged identity, empty directory and exact resolved path, after native terminal evidence is durably published.
global_jvm_lock.ownership: Separate owned K PID/token/identity receipt, not a file in shared empty lock directory

execution_protocol.receipt_policy: Create-only claims; mutable native/final receipts use owned same-directory temp+flush/fsync+atomic replace. Persist terminal evidence before lock release, then persist release state.

child_environment.home_and_cache_paths: Owned K home directories; JVM properties in exact argv bind all JVM temp/home/preferences/native caches/error/dump paths

common.source_status: Existing source bytes copied verbatim; no Java/POM/test generation
common.source_guard: All immutable local donor inputs and five upstream postimages match exact Git blob and SHA256 before and after every action. Mutable image states follow each command before/after map.

acceptance: Each command requires its exact expected exit code and log contract; exit zero alone is insufficient.
Verify all immutable input and tool hashes before and after every action.
Verify the entire five-target state and absence conditions before and after every image action.
Current check and every check action leave all bytes unchanged.
Baseline and each narrow successful apply produce exact current postimages; two KEEP files unchanged.
Drift refuses at preflight before any writes: all four existing files unchanged and proof remains ABSENT.
No additional file or temporary residue is permitted inside an image.
All sixteen owned jobs must be terminal, active0 and handle-closed; expected drift exit1 is required.
Acquire global JVM lock once, HOLD if present; release only the acquired identity after durable terminal evidence.
